content:
Honored to serve as an Assessor for the preliminary rounds of 4th Samanvay International Mediation Competition, 2026 at Himachal Pradesh National Law University Shimla.  

It was a rewarding experience evaluating the participants' negotiation and mediation frameworks, and I am confident that the rigorous rounds will serve them well in their legal careers.  

Kudos to Dr. Ruchi Gupta and the organizing team for a seamless and impactful event!
comment: The real test of mediation is whether participants can adapt when negotiations become emotionally charged or power imbalances emerge. That practical judgment often matters more than the framework itself.
